name: FV RUN – Run with Heart, Run for Hope 2026
short_description: FV RUN – Run with Heart, Run for Hope is on Sunday 1 November 2026 at Phu My Hung urban area in Ho Chi Minh City, over 5 km, 10 km and 21 km, plus a 3 x 1 km family relay.
ai_summary: FV RUN – Run with Heart, Run for Hope 2026 is the first edition of a community charity run organised by FV Hospital with the Nang Buoc Tuoi Tho charity fund. The event runs 31 October to 1 November 2026, and iRace lists the races on 1 November in the Phu My Hung urban area, Tan Hung ward, with a 03:30 to 10:30 window. Distances are 5 km, 10 km and 21 km, plus a family relay of 3 x 1 km. The organiser states that 100% of ticket revenue goes to the fund to pay for surgery for children from poor families.

core_facts.venue: Phu My Hung urban area, Tan Hung ward
core_facts.organizer: FV Hospital, co-organised with the Nang Buoc Tuoi Tho charity fund

faqs.question: What are the age limits and cut-offs at FV RUN – Run with Heart, Run for Hope 2026?
faqs.answer: The Pace8 registration page sets a minimum age of 16 and a 3 hour 30 minute cut-off for the 21 km. The 10 km is for runners aged 10 and over with a 2 hour 15 minute cut-off, and the 5 km is for ages 6 and over with a 1 hour 15 minute cut-off. The family relay needs one member aged 6 to 14 and has a 1 hour cut-off.

faqs.question: How much does FV RUN – Run with Heart, Run for Hope 2026 cost?
faqs.answer: In the regular phase listed on Pace8 the 21 km costs VND 1,050,000, the 10 km VND 850,000 and the 5 km VND 650,000. The 3 x 1 km family relay costs VND 980,000 per team. The 21 km entry includes a finisher shirt.
